_note: Reconstructed by concatenating per-operation OpenAPI 3.1 fragments served verbatim by readme.paradox.ai/reference/*.md (ReadMe.io docs platform). Each fragment is a real, machine-served OpenAPI document scoped to one operation; this file merges all 53 recovered operations into one document for readability. Not a single consolidated spec file served by Paradox itself -- no such single file was found.

Redacted to <REDACTED:AWS_KEY_ID> / <REDACTED:SIG> per ingestion.md §7 rule 3 regardless of the credential's age/liveness.

put.description: This API allows 3rd party integrators to send Interview Requests to Paradox.  Additionally, this API will create Candidates within Paradox that do not exist.

job_application_id.description: A candidate's external job application ID. (max length: 255 )

use_application_id_for_identity.description: Use the candidate’s Job Application ID as their unique identifier. Using this parameter will allow for candidates to be created and scheduled from this endpoint.

action.description: The action of interview: "interview" (send interview times to candidate), "reschedule" (reschedule the interview), "cancel" (cancel the interview)  (max length: 10)

interview_duration.description: Interview duration in minutes. The maximum amount of time is  415 minutes and the minimum is 5.

interview_type.description: IN_PERSON_INTERVIEW = 1 PHONE_INTERVIEW = 2 IN_PERSON_MEETING = 3 PHONE_MEETING = 4 SEQUENTIAL_INTERVIEW = 5 SEQUENTIAL_MEETING = 6 VIRTUAL_INTERVIEW = 7 VIRTUAL_MEETING = 8 GROUP_INTERVIEW = 9 PHONE_CONVERSATION = 10 IN_PERSON_CONVERSATION = 11 VIRTUAL_CONVERSATION = 12 IN_PERSON_SESSION = 13 PHONE_SESSION = 14 SEQUENTIAL_SESSION = 15 VIRTUAL_SESSION = 16 GROUP_SESSION = 17 INTERVIEW_PREFERENCE = 18 BREAK = 19 (max length: 6)

custom_interview_type.description: The API ID of the custom interview type

interview_segments.description: Interview parameters for each segment of a sequential interview. This parameter can only be used when a sequential interview_type has been selected.

interview_name.description: Name of the interview segment that will be communicated with the candidate

interview_duration.description: Interview duration in minutes. The maximum amount of time is  415 minutes and the minimum is 5.

interview_type.description: IN_PERSON_INTERVIEW = 1, PHONE_INTERVIEW = 2, IN_PERSON_MEETING = 3, PHONE_MEETING = 4, SEQUENTIAL_INTERVIEW = 5, SEQUENTIAL_MEETING = 6, VIRTUAL_INTERVIEW = 7, VIRTUAL_MEETING = 8 (max length: 6)

interviewer_emails.description: List of email address of the interviewer(s). (max length: 255 )

interviewer_ex_ids.description: List of external employee IDs of the interviewer(s). Ex : ["e5464656","2523525"] (max length of employee id: 255)

interview_team.description: A dynamic round-robin group based on receiving a list of either user emails or employee IDs. Ex ["u_1234", 2523525, abc@example.com].

interviewer_ids.description: List of the interview attendees. Ex:["u_636","u_74","g_6","exg_1089"] = User ID 636 and 74 and Round Robin Group ID = 6 and External Group ID = 1089 . (max length of user id: 10).

interview_location_address.description: The location on the in-person interview API request that does not match a location in location management.

interview_jobloc_code.description: The external location ID of the interview job location.

interview_jobloc_id.description: The Paradox ID of the interview job location.

interview_jobloc_room_email.description: The room email in job loc room

interviewer_emails.description: List of email address of the interviewer(s). (max length: 255 ) Endpoint will accept either a comma separated list or array of objects.

interviewer_ex_ids.description: List of external employee IDs of the interviewer(s). Ex : ["e5464656","2523525"] (max length of employee id: 255) Endpoint will accept either a comma separated list or array of objects. When using the objects to specify which interviewers are optional the "Enable Validation for Interview Alerts Scheduling" toggle must be turned on

interview_team.description: A dynamic round-robin group based on receiving a list of either user emails or employee IDs. Ex '["u_1234", "2523525", "abc@example.com"]'. It can have up to a maximum of 25 interviewers. User's priority is High

alternate_interview_team.description: A dynamic round-robin group based on receiving a list of either user emails or employee IDs. Ex '["u_1234", "2523525", "abc@example.com"]'. It can have up to a maximum of 25 interviewers. User's priority is Medium

interviewer_ids.description: List of Paradox IDs to identify the interview attendees. Ex:["u_636","u_74","g_6","exg_1089"] = User ID 636 and 74 and Round Robin Group ID = 6 and External Group ID = 1089 . (max length of user id: 10). Endpoint will accept either a comma separated list or array of objects.

interview_jobloc_code.description: The external location ID of the interview job location.

interview_jobloc_room_id.description: The Paradox id of the interview room. If -1 is sent as the value, the Paradox logic of “Any Available Room” will be utilized.

interview_jobloc_id.description: The Paradox ID of the interview job location.

interview_location_address.description: A valid street address to be used for the interview location. This does not have to be an existing location in the Paradox environment.

candidate_interview_prep_ex_id.description: The Interview Prep External ID of the candidate (max length: 255 )
